== Summary ==
[[Matt Scott]] (left) in a match at the feature table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Matt Scott is the player in the black-and-white track jacket in [[:File:2021 World Championship Final Confrontation.jpg]] (captioned "Matt Scott and Joe Olson") and in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] ("Scott", top right).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
